entities.name: Mislav Kolakušić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mislav Kolakušić is a Croatian lawyer and politician who has been a Member of the European Parliament for Croatia from 2 July 2019 to 16 July 2024, having been elected to the position at the 2019 election as an Independent. Previously, he served as a judge at the Zagreb Commercial Court.
